title: Durable, sewn in handles
text: Durable, sewn in handles. These baskets are nice for storage.  I love that the handle is sewn on vs a rope through a hole.  I had some with the rope through the hole and it ended up popping through.  These are sturdy and the color is as in the photo.  The reason for 4 stars is because although it's supposed to be collapsable, it's too collapsable.  The walls keep caving.  If you plan to use it for something that you won't be emptying out often, these will work great for you!
